objective: Lay the frontend foundation every later unit builds on: a deterministic OpenAPI export from the backend, the generated typed client with an injected-token auth middleware, a single validated configuration module, the react-router shell, the react-query provider, and the msw test harness. No feature behaviour — this unit is the skeleton and the contract.
acceptance_criteria: Running backend/scripts/export_openapi.py writes backend/openapi.json with sorted keys, two-space indentation and a trailing newline; running it a second time produces a byte-identical file.
A backend test fails when the committed backend/openapi.json differs from a freshly exported one, and names the drift in its failure message.
frontend/src/config.ts throws at module load when a required VITE_ variable is absent or empty, and the error names the missing variable.
frontend/src/config.ts exposes apiBaseUrl, cognitoRegion, cognitoUserPoolId, cognitoClientId and mediaBaseUrl as typed non-empty strings when all variables are present.
A test asserts that no file under frontend/src other than config.ts reads import.meta.env.
apiClient sends an Authorization header of 'Bearer <token>' from its injected token provider on every request, and sends no Authorization header at all when the provider returns null.
apiClient is constructed as createClient<paths> against the generated frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts, and npm run typecheck passes.
The router renders a distinct view for each of /, /compose, /notifications, /search, /profile/:userId and the auth routes, and renders a not-found view for an unmatched path.
A component rendered through the shared test render helper has both a QueryClientProvider and a router in scope, and each test file gets a fresh QueryClient with retries disabled.
frontend/src/test/server.ts exports an msw server whose handlers are typed against paths from the generated schema, and an unhandled request fails the test rather than passing silently.
